note: Fixture: forward results of AH hypothesis filters. Paper tracking only.

AH1.label: Large unders (4+ pt move, under side)
AH1.rule: MOVES where Pinnacle move >= 4 pts AND side = under

AH2.label: Late + large (last 90 min, move 3+ pts)
AH2.rule: MOVES where window is 90->45 or 45->20 AND move >= 3 pts

AH3.label: Solo + late (solo Pinnacle, last 90 min)
AH3.rule: MOVES where others < 1 pt AND window is 90->45 or 45->20

AH4.label: Stale HR + FAIR (HR stale, EV >= 0)
AH4.rule: MOVES where HR price unchanged (stale) AND ev_pin >= 0

AH5.label: Large solo (4+ pt solo Pinnacle move)
AH5.rule: MOVES where move >= 4 pts AND others < 1 pt

AH8.label: Unders in last 90 min
AH8.rule: MOVES where side = under AND window in last 90 min

AH9.label: 2-4 books following (consensus middle band)
AH9.rule: MOVES where 2-4 other books moved >= 1 pt the same way

AH10.label: Large move unders by size band (3-4 vs 4+)
AH10.rule: MOVES: unders, split 3-4 pts vs 4+ pts

AH11.label: Morning overs vs unders
AH11.rule: MOVES in 11AM->90 window, split by side

AH12.label: Solo large (3+ pt, solo Pinnacle)
AH12.rule: MOVES where move >= 3 pts AND others < 1 pt

AH13.label: Stale HR + unders
AH13.rule: MOVES where HR price unchanged AND side = under

AH14.label: Small FAIR moves (2-3 pt, ev_pin >= 0)
AH14.rule: MOVES where move 2-3 pts AND ev_pin >= 0

AH15.label: Late + FAIR (last 90 min, ev_pin >= 0)
AH15.rule: MOVES where window is last 90 min AND ev_pin >= 0
